captures.title: Create the admin account on first run
captures.transcript: A fresh CryoZen instance opens on the first-time setup screen. The username alex is typed, a password is entered and confirmed, and Create Admin Account is clicked. CryoZen signs in and opens Settings on the Integrations tab, where the catalog of services to connect is listed.

captures.title: Connect a local model
captures.transcript: Settings opens from the sidebar gear on the Add Models tab. The address of an Ollama running on the Docker host, http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1, is pasted into the Local endpoint field, and Test reports the server online with two models found, qwen3:14b and gemma2:2b. Add saves the endpoint under Added Models and selects qwen3:14b for chat. Settings is closed, the composer shows the selected model, and its model picker lists both models.

captures.title: Chat with a local model
captures.transcript: A new chat is open. The model picker in the composer switches from gemma2:2b to qwen3:14b, both served by a local Ollama. The question asks for a two-sentence explanation of compound interest, the formula in LaTeX, and a Mermaid flowchart. The reply streams in after a short thinking phase; the waiting time is trimmed from the video. The finished answer shows the formula typeset as math and the flowchart drawn as a diagram, both rendered locally.

captures.title: Web search in chat with sources
captures.transcript: In a new chat the Web search button in the composer is switched on. The question How do tides work is sent, CryoZen searches the web through its bundled SearXNG instance, and the answer streams in; the wait is trimmed. Expanding Web sources lists the numbered pages the answer drew on, as links.

captures.title: Edit living documents with AI
captures.transcript: Library opens from the sidebar, the Release notes 1.4 draft document is expanded, and Open docks the document editor beside the chat. The request Add an Upgrade notes section at the end: back up the database, run the migration, then restart the service, with a one-line reply, is sent; with a document open the chat runs in Agent mode, and the model writes the new section into the document, which is accepted if it is offered for review. The model wait is trimmed. The version badge now shows a new version, and the version history panel lists v2 and v1 with their line differences; the pointer moves over v1 and a Restore button, which would bring an older version back as a new version, without clicking.

captures.title: Memory that carries across chats
captures.transcript: Brain opens from the sidebar and lists the saved memories about Alex and Northwind Labs. On the Add tab, the fact Bluefin Analytics is our first pilot customer is added with the project category. In a new chat, the question When does release 1.4 ship, and who is our first pilot customer is answered with December 3 and Bluefin Analytics, drawn from memory; the model wait is trimmed. Clicking the memory pill under the answer lists the memories that were used.

captures.title: Keep notes and checklists
captures.transcript: Notes opens as a side panel next to the chat. On the pinned Release 1.4 checklist, the item Publish the release notes is checked off. A new to-do titled Pilot kickoff prep is created with two items, Share the agenda and Book the demo room, tagged #launch, colored green, and saved. Clicking the #launch chip filters to launch notes, and the Today chip shows the next step from each goal.

captures.title: Mail with AI summaries and replies
captures.transcript: Email opens from the sidebar with the fictional Northwind inbox, five unread messages from a local test mail server. The message Onboarding screens ready for review, from Sam Okafor, is opened. Summary and Generate now produce a short AI summary of the message; the model wait is trimmed. AI reply with the Fast option drafts a reply that opens for editing before sending.

captures.title: Plan the week in Calendar
captures.transcript: Calendar opens from the sidebar and is dragged to the top edge to fill the screen, then switched to the Week view showing the seeded Northwind meetings. In Quick add, the text Lunch w/ Mira, with the date of Thursday, 12:30pm-1:30pm, Cafe Mango is typed and Enter is pressed. CryoZen turns it into an event form with the title, date, times, and location filled in; the short wait for the model is trimmed. Create adds the event; the week grid is scrolled down to the afternoon, where it appears on Thursday.

captures.title: Draft a scheduled task with AI
captures.transcript: Tasks opens from the sidebar with the scheduled jobs listed. On Add, the description Every Friday at 4pm, summarize this week's notes into a short status update is typed, and Draft with AI fills in the task form with a weekly Friday 4 pm schedule and a prompt; the model wait is trimmed. Create saves the task, its card appears in the list, and Run starts it immediately.

captures.title: See which models fit your hardware
captures.transcript: Compute opens from the sidebar. Scan / Download shows the detected hardware of this Docker container, with no GPU and its RAM and cores, and a table of models ranked by fit, VRAM, context, speed, and score. EDIT opens the hardware simulator; one GPU with 24 GB of VRAM and 64 GB of RAM is entered and applied, and the table re-ranks for that profile. The Quant filter is then set to Q4.

captures.title: Gallery and layer editor
captures.transcript: Gallery opens from the sidebar with a grid of original landscape illustrations and is dragged to fullscreen. The alpine-sunset image is opened, and Edit launches the layer editor, fit to view. Adjust layer adds a Hue / Saturation adjustment; dragging the Hue and Saturation sliders recolors the mountains live, and Apply keeps the change on its own layer.

captures.title: Switch and customize themes
captures.transcript: The Theme window opens from the sidebar. Clicking the paper, retrowave, and terminal presets restyles the whole app instantly, then the default cryozen preset comes back. On the Customize tab, the window is dragged taller, Background / Effect is set to Perlin Flow, the result is saved as a custom theme named Northwind Night, and Intensity is turned up. Closing the window shows the animated effect behind the conversation.

captures.title: Run JavaScript in a sandbox
captures.transcript: In a new chat, the request asks for a short JavaScript snippet that estimates pi from 200,000 random points, with only the code in the reply. The answer arrives as a code block with Run, Edit, and Copy buttons; the model wait is trimmed. Clicking Run executes the code in a sandboxed worker inside the browser, and the logged estimate of pi appears directly beneath the code block.

captures.title: Find any conversation with Ctrl+K
captures.transcript: From an empty chat, Ctrl+K opens conversation search. Typing handshake finds the earlier TCP handshake conversation with the match highlighted, and clicking the result opens that chat. Ctrl+K again and typing digest lists the matching messages from the conversation about naming a weekly digest email, with the word highlighted.
